messages:
maya: Hey team — we're seeing intermittent 401s on CI deploys (only on self-hosted runners, ~5% of jobs). Started ~09:12 UTC, correlates with job time ~45-70m. logs attached in thread. :eyes:

devon: Can you paste the error snippet? is it `invalid_token` or `insufficient_scope`?

maya: here's the stripped log:
```
2026-03-16T09:15:01Z deployer: POST /v1/deploys -> 401
{"error":"unauthorized","reason":"token_expired_or_missing_scope"}
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/deploys
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
```

sam: that message is consistent with either TTL expiry or the service account missing the `deploy:write` permission. Do we know which SA the runner is using?

maya: it's the gha-runner service account (ci-runner@org). The runner image caches the delegated token for 50m (see runner config: `TOKEN_CACHE=3000s`). The token TTL from our identity service is 1h (3600s). If a token is minted at t=0 and cached for 50m, a long job hitting at t=55m would still present the cached token which is within TTL — but we're seeing 401s at ~45-70m which hints at TTL skew or early rotation.

irene: checked audit logs: at 09:10 UTC we rotated the SA key material (scheduled rotation). Runners that kept older short-lived tokens started failing once policy enforcement checked key version. Audit shows `token_issued_at: 09:05:03`, `token_expiry: 10:05:03`, but enforcement returned 401 for tokens signed with old key after rotation window. So it's a key-rotation / cache-stale mismatch.

devon: ok — quick mitigations: 1) reduce runner TOKEN_CACHE to 30m, 2) add pre-job refresh step to call `gha-runnerctl refresh-tokens`, or 3) extend token TTL for the CI SA to 2h while we roll runners. Which is least invasive?

sam: quick fix = pre-job refresh. config snippet to add to workflow runner startup:
```
# pre-run refresh
TOKEN=$(gha-runnerctl mint --sa ci-runner@org --scope deploy:write)
export REDWOOD_TOKEN="$TOKEN"
```

irene: long-term: we should 1) update runner image to refresh at 60% of TTL, 2) make rotation grace window explicit in identity service (allow 5m overlap), and 3) audit SA scopes — I see some runners only request `deploy:read`. Patch incoming to workflows to request `deploy:write` where needed.

sre-bot: Escalation created: RH-8932 — infra will track runner image + identity grace window. Priority P2.

maya: repro steps for support ticket / customer: 1) run a job that sleeps ~50m then does a deploy curl with cached token. 2) capture `curl -v` and `/audit/token` entries. 3) if 401, confirm token `kid` vs current key version with `identityctl key-version --sa ci-runner@org`.

devon: I'll patch the workflow to call `gha-runnerctl refresh-tokens` before deploy and roll those changes to 10% canary this afternoon. Thanks — will update RH-8932 with rollout status. :thumbsup:
